commentary.text: 90+11' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.

90+9' 2 - 1 It's a goal! Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) makes it 2:1. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Moi Gomez and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Odysseas Vlachodimos was helpless.
90+8' Jon Moncayola (Osasuna) launches the ball from the resulting corner, but one of the defenders is first to the ball and deals with the threat.
90+7' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the right post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.
90+6' Akor Adams (Sevilla) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
90+4' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Miguel Ortiz had an easy-decision to make.
90+2' 12:7 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
